name: Blood-Cursed Weapons hastes the party when Crimson Tide is cast (#2246)
contract: Blood-Cursed Weapons 684331 reads 'Casting Crimson Tide now additionally increases the haste of all party and raid members by $685029s1% for $685029d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Blood-Cursed Weapons 685029, two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID effects (SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS and SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE, BasePoints 4 -> +5%, radius index 12, TargetA 1). Spell.dbc gives 684331 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no party member ever received 685029. Crimson Tide is cast as 504282, the highest-numbered of the nine family-26 Crimson Tide records (504129-504136, 504282) that all carry SpellFamilyFlags (16384, 0, 0); it costs 400 Rage and has ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 802877, so no Cursed Form marker is fixtured.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Blood-Cursed Weapons passive is active
No Blood-Cursed Weapons buff on the ally before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: the ally gains Blood-Cursed Weapons 685029
Blood-Cursed Weapons grants the DBC value of +5% haste
